vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: haodf
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle consists of metadata and markdown instructions (SKILL.md) designed to guide an AI agent in helping users find medical specialists. It contains no executable code, lacks any data exfiltration or remote execution capabilities, and includes appropriate medical disclaimers.

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (finding/recommending doctors); it requests no credentials or installs and poses low technical risk, though it handles sensitive health information and is vague about data sources for ratings/reviews.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the SKILL.md content: the skill's instructions focus on mapping symptoms to specialties, filtering by location, and recommending doctors. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or install steps requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions legitimately cover clarifying symptoms, location, specialty mapping, and presenting recommendations. However, the SKILL.md tells the agent to 'check ratings, experience, patient reviews' and provide booking info without specifying trusted data sources or boundaries; that ambiguity could cause the agent to perform broad web searches or surface unverified information. Also, the skill will handle sensitive health data but doesn't include explicit guidance on minimizing or protecting personally identifiable health details.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only (no install spec, no code files). This minimizes on-disk risk and there are no external downloads or package installs to review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That is proportionate for a doctor-recommendation helper which, as written, only provides guidance and suggested outputs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill has no install or persistent configuration. It does not request elevated or cross-skill privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low risk from a technical perspective (no installs, no credentials). Before enabling, consider: 1) the skill will handle sensitive health information — limit collection to what’s necessary and avoid storing or transmitting personal identifiers; 2) the SKILL.md is vague about where ratings/reviews/booking info come from — decide whether the agent should be allowed to browse the web, and if so, restrict trusted sources or require citations; 3) remind users this is not medical advice and verify any recommended doctors or appointment details directly with hospitals. If you need stronger privacy or provenance guarantees, ask the skill author to add explicit source constraints and data-handling rules.
